refactoring_examples.overview: Complete examples of SRP-based refactoring, based on the OCRCoordinateService case.

example.name: ocr_coordinate_service_refactoring
example.scenario: The OCRCoordinateService class violates SRP by handling: 1. Data access (DB queries, file loading) 2. Search algorithms (text search, multi-box substring, proximity) 3. Feedback processing (template feedback)

step.approach: Read the class and list all methods. Group them by responsibility: - Data access: _get_ocr_entries, _load_raw_data - Search algorithms: _find_multi_boxes_by_substring - Orchestration: process_feedback - Feedback processing: _process_correction_feedback
step.expected_outcome: Clear list of 4 responsibilities to separate.

step.approach: Create a new file app/services/ocr_search_strategies.py with: - TextSearchStrategy (wraps search_coordinates) - MultiBoxSubstringStrategy (extracted from _find_multi_boxes_by_substring) - OCRSearchStrategy protocol

Change OCRCoordinateService.__init__ to accept: - repository (for data access) - search_strategies (list of strategy instances) - feedback_processor (for feedback processing) Remove direct db_path and output_dir dependencies.

step.description: Update process_feedback to use injected dependencies
step.approach: Replace direct calls to _get_ocr_entries with repository.get_ocr_entries(). Replace direct search calls with strategy.search(). Replace _process_correction_feedback with feedback_processor.process().
Update ReceiptService and ReceiptUpdater to construct OCRCoordinateService with the new DI-based constructor.

example.completion: OCRCoordinateService now only orchestrates: it delegates data access to a repository, search to strategies, and feedback to a processor. Each component has a single responsibility.
